name: error_answers_in_users_language
description: Every failure path used to answer with a hardcoded English sentence. A client writing Spanish was told 'I didn't quite understand your request'.

turns.message: sube las tareas del proyecto Inexistente SA al tablero que no existe
turns.why: A request that cannot succeed. What matters is the language of the refusal.

assert.comment: Spanish in, Spanish out, even when nothing worked.
